title: Unlocking Bias Detection: Leveraging Transformer-Based Models for Content Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated via sentence-level and token-level classification using the Contextualized Bi-Directional Dual Transformer (CBDT) to identify gender-based stereotypes and biased lexicons, measured by macro-averaged F1-scores.
Evaluated via token-level and sequence-level classification using the CBDT model to pinpoint racially biased terms and context, measured by macro-averaged F1-scores.
Evaluated via token-level classification to detect biased lexicons and narratives related to religion using the CBDT model, measured by macro-averaged F1-scores.
Evaluated via token-level classification to identify ageist stereotypes (e.g., perceiving older employees as less adaptable) using the CBDT model, measured by macro-averaged F1-scores.
Evaluated via token-level classification to detect ableist language and stereotypes regarding physical disabilities and productivity using the CBDT model, measured by macro-averaged F1-scores.
Evaluated via token-level classification to identify biases related to income level, wealth, and social status using the CBDT model, measured by macro-averaged F1-scores.
Evaluated via token-level classification to detect biased terminology and framing in climate change news using the CBDT model, measured by macro-averaged F1-scores.
Evaluated via token-level classification to detect biases in health and wellness narratives (e.g., in clinical notes) using the CBDT model, measured by macro-averaged F1-scores.
